messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: latency.p99 > 1.2s for /v1/chat/completions across region-us-east (models: gpt-large, redwood-7b) — firing 3m
maria: I’m looking at it now. Seeing p99 spike ~1.4s on gpt-large; redwood-7b p99 ~1.25s. p95 mostly fine.
ajay: Any customer-facing errors?
maria: No 5xxs. Errors are mostly timeouts in downstream redis cache hits for KV cache. A few tail requests retried, but no large request failures.
kevin: Paging in case we need to do immediate routing changes. @sam / @lia FYI.
lia: On it. Can we confirm if Dedicated customers are affected?
maria: Quick check: dedicated tenants A/B show slight p99 bump but within SLA for most; enterprise-corp-x saw increased 95th for a couple routes — reaching 800ms which triggered a support ticket.
ajay: TL;DR: impact is latency increase for chat completions p99, limited customer ticket from enterprise-corp-x, not widespread errors.
kevin: Proposed quick mitigation: temporarily widen p99 alert threshold to 1.5s for chat/completions for the next 2 hours to reduce noise while we triage. Also add per-model p99 alerts instead of global. Thoughts?
maria: I like per-model. We had noisy alerting before because gpt-large spikes while small models stay fine.
lia: +1. Also want a short-term routing tweak: route new requests to redwood-7b variants in us-west for enterprise-corp-x if latency continues.
ajay: Before we change thresholds, can we create a dashboard slice for per-route p99 and last-minute KDE of latencies? I don’t want to hide real customer pain.
kevin: Agreed. What about immediate action: I can put a 2-hour mute on the global chat/completions p99 alert and open a new per-model p99 alert with thresholds: gpt-large=1.6s, redwood-7b=1.3s, redwood-3b=1.0s. If everyone ok I’ll push.
lia: ok for a temporary mute, but please annotate incident and link to ticket.
maria: Working on root cause: redis cluster in us-east has elevated tail latencies at node ip-10.4.7.21 — team is scaling up replicas now.
kevin: If redis is root cause, we should add a cache-miss metric on dashboards as well.
ajay: Action items: 1) temporary mute global p99 alert (kevin) 2) create per-model p99 alerts (kevin) 3) add per-route & cache-miss dashboards (maria, ajay) 4) route override plan for enterprise-corp-x if persists (lia) 5) update runbook/alert docs (sam).
sam: Adding runbook update to my queue. Also please include guidance to prefer p95 for automated paging and p99 for manual review.
maria: Redis replica scaled, tail latencies falling. p99 for gpt-large down to ~1.1s across the board.
kevin: I’ve applied the 2h mute to the global chat/completions p99 and created new per-model alerts. Posting the config here:
```
alert: chat.completions.p99.gpt-large
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{model="gpt-large",route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.6
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
```
```
alert: chat.completions.p99.redwood-7b
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{model="redwood-7b",route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.3
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
```
kevin: I also added annotations on the alert to include link to redis mem stats and the incident ticket.
lia: Routing override queued. Will only flip if enterprise-corp-x ticket shows ongoing >1.2s p95 for next 30m.
ajay: I spun up a per-route latency dashboard and added a panel for cache_miss_ratio by shard. Maria, can you double-check the thresholds look reasonable?
maria: The dashboard looks good. Suggest raising redwood-7b threshold to 1.35s — observed steady-state tail usually sits ~1.2s.
kevin: OK adjusting redwood-7b to 1.35s. Pushed change.
sam: I’ll capture this as a post-incident action item: alert strategy doc — recommend p95 auto-pager, p99 pager for aggregated business-impacting routes, and per-model thresholds. Assigning to @ajay for draft.
ajay: Got it. I’ll prepare a short doc and PR for the alerts repo.
maria: Final status update: redis tail latencies normalized, per-model p99s under new thresholds, no additional customer tickets. Closing active mitigation.
kevin: Removing the 2h mute early since things are stable. I left the per-model alerts enabled.
lia: I’ll follow up with the support lead for enterprise-corp-x to confirm they’re seeing normal performance.
sam: Thanks all. Please add any lingering items to the incident tracker.
maria: adding notes to the incident ticket now.
oncall-bot: Incident incident-2026-03-15-redis-latency closed by maria at 1791236789
kevin: good job team :thumbsup:
